review.editorial: Reread the action separately for intelligible positions, successive actions and causes. Established why available choices narrow rather than relying on abrupt unexplained transitions.
review.continuity_or_facts: Tracked handedness, possessions and locations across the preceding ending and following opening; kept physical consequences distinct from ability limitations.
review.english_alignment: Checked subject changes, concrete action verbs and local guide spans. Retained sentence-sized units for study features and inspected coloured character text at phone width.

samples.notes: Viewed phone pinyin opening: tone marks and coloured chunks remain legible, with meaningful local English guides.
Viewed phone character midpoint: source wraps clearly and the guide follows the local sentence without unexplained English gaps.
Viewed phone character ending: final punctuation and closing guide remain readable above the page indicator.
Viewed the actual app at desktop width: centred reading column, source and English remain legible with no horizontal clipping.
